stewards.name: x402 Foundation (x402 a Series of LF Projects, LLC)
stewards.role: Governs the protocol under a technical charter adopted 2026-03-31, as a Linux Foundation project announced on 2026-04-02. A Governing Board handles budget and business oversight and the TSC makes technical decisions; Michael Hursta (Linux Foundation) has been Executive Director since 2026-10-01.

stewards.name: Technical Steering Committee: Coinbase, Cloudflare, Stripe
stewards.role: Votes on technical decisions; named in TSC.md on 2026-05-12.

stewards.name: Coinbase Developer Platform
stewards.role: Originated x402 and wrote the 2025-05-06 whitepaper; runs the largest facilitator by transactions and volume in x402scan figures reported on 2026-07-21.

implementers.name: Coinbase CDP facilitator
implementers.role: Facilitator on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Monad, World and Solana with KYT and OFAC screening (CDP docs, 2026-10-19).

implementers.name: Facilitators listed in the x402 docs (PayAI, Corbits, Dexter, Fireblocks, Polygon, Celo, NEAR x402 Facilitator, T54 XRPL and others)
implementers.role: Independent verify and settle services; the docs say the list is not exhaustive.

implementers.name: Cloudflare Monetization Gateway
implementers.role: Closed beta that settles USDC on Base through Coinbase's facilitator; US sellers and buyers only.

implementers.name: Cloudflare Agents SDK
implementers.role: withX402 and paidTool for agents and MCP servers since 2025-09-23.

implementers.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway machine payments
implementers.role: Pays for inference on select models over x402 when a request carries the Cloudflare-specific Payment-Method: x402 header; since 2026-09-30, for US-based customers.

implementers.name: Circle Nanopayments (Circle Gateway)
implementers.role: Gas-free USDC payments from $0.000001 using EIP-3009 inside the x402 flow, batched settlement.

implementers.name: Stripe machine payments preview
implementers.role: Charges agents in USDC on Base through x402 and records each settled payment as a PaymentIntent; open to US businesses outside New York, other countries on request (2026-10-19).

implementers.name: Coinbase Agentic Wallets
implementers.role: Coinbase-managed agent wallet that holds USDC and pays for x402 services within limits the owner sets, through the awal CLI or an MCP server; available since 2026-02-11.

implementers.name: x402scan (Merit Systems)
implementers.role: Explorer, registry and public API for x402 activity.

implementers.name: Google a2a-x402 and AP2 samples
implementers.role: A2A extension and human-present and human-not-present x402 samples.

sdks.name: @x402/core
sdks.note: V2 core types, client and resource server. Versions in this list as of 2026-10-19; no SDK implemented the Lightning (lnbtc) binding on that date.

sdks.name: x402
sdks.note: Legacy V1 package (unscoped); x402-axios, x402-express, x402-fetch, x402-hono and x402-next are V1 too.

sdks.name: x402
sdks.note: V2 Python SDK, not legacy. Extras include httpx, requests, fastapi, flask, evm, svm, tvm, mcp and extensions.

sdks.name: Java module (java/)
sdks.note: In the repository; no published artifact found.

metrics.definition: Stars on the canonical repository (GitHub API, read 2026-10-19).
npm registry downloads of the V2 core package in the 30 days from 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-16 (last-month endpoint, read 2026-10-19).
metrics.caveat: Includes CI installs; the legacy V1 package x402 had 1,910,242 in the same window.

metrics.definition: Self-reported counter on the x402.org home page, with no date or method on the page. First archived with this value on 2025-12-14 (Wayback Machine) and still shown on 2026-10-19.
metrics.caveat: Unchanged on 2026-10-19; not a live 30-day figure. x402scan reported 3.02M transactions in the 30 days to 2026-10-19, and a Base study measured about 145,500 settlements a day from January to June 2026.

metrics.definition: Self-reported counter on the x402.org home page, with no date or method on the page. First archived with this value on 2025-12-14 (Wayback Machine) and still shown on 2026-10-19.
metrics.caveat: Unchanged on 2026-10-19; not a live 30-day figure. x402scan reported $1.23M in the 30 days to 2026-10-19; in March 2026 a16z put the same 30 days at about $3M on chain and $1.6M after removing wash trades.

metrics.definition: Cumulative from the May 2025 launch to 2026-04-21, excluding identified wash and test activity (Artemis's proprietary method); about $0.14 per transaction. Raw totals were over $135.7M across 178.3M transactions.
metrics.caveat: Report commissioned by Visa. On 2026-07-16 The Defiant reported Visa's Cuy Sheffield citing about $19M across about 134M adjusted transactions, with no data date.

metrics.metric: Share of transactions flagged as gamed (Artemis)
metrics.definition: Average share of x402 transactions Artemis flagged as gamed between 2025-11-09 and 2026-02-07 (peak 90.21 percent), reported by Four Pillars. A separate Base study (2025-09-17 to 2026-06-23, different method) classes 21.20 percent of settlements as fictitious and 63.78 percent as internal to linked clusters.
metrics.caveat: Secondary report of Artemis data; the detection logic is not published.

metrics.definition: x402 settlements on Base from 2025-09-17 to 2026-06-23 (280 days), counted in arXiv:2607.12575 (submitted 2026-07-14).
metrics.caveat: The paper argues settlement counts are not adoption because they can be manufactured almost for free.

metrics.definition: Claim in the V2 launch post.
metrics.caveat: Raw self-reported count. Visa and Artemis counted about 38M adjusted transactions in November 2025 and 109.6M adjusted (178.3M raw) from launch to 2026-04-21.

metrics.definition: Quote from Rishin Sharma (Solana Foundation) in the Linux Foundation release of 2026-04-02, for 2026 to date; a self-reported figure from an interested party.
metrics.caveat: Crypto Briefing reported about 70 percent of monthly volume for mid August 2026. Visa and Artemis data (adjusted, cumulative to 2026-04-21) put Base at about 90 percent of transactions and 93 percent of volume; the windows differ.

metrics.definition: Past 30 Days view of x402scan's overall stats, read 2026-10-19; the same view showed $1.23M in volume.
metrics.caveat: x402scan's own indexing of facilitator settlements; trackers count differently.

metrics.definition: Range across unnamed trackers reported by Crypto Briefing on 2026-09-15.
metrics.caveat: Trackers count differently: x402scan showed 234.69M all-time transactions on 2026-10-19, and Chainalysis reported more than 138 million x402 transactions on Base by the end of its 2026 report period (2026-10-14).

metrics.definition: Organizations listed on x402.org/members: 19 Premier, 26 General and 12 Associate.
metrics.caveat: 40 at the 2026-07-14 launch, 17 of them Premier; the Linux Foundation said more than 50 active members on 2026-10-01.

costs.value: First 1,000 on-chain transactions each month free, then $0.001 per on-chain transaction
costs.caveat: Counts on-chain transactions, not payment requests. CDP began charging on 2026-01-01 after announcing it on 2025-12-01; check the page for current rates.

costs.value: exact and EVM upto: one; Solana upto: two; batch-settlement: one claim covers many vouchers
costs.whoPays: Facilitator pays gas; the seller pays CDP's fee per on-chain transaction
costs.caveat: Deposits, refunds and withdrawals in batch-settlement count as one transaction each.

costs.value: On-chain gas plus 30 percent per settlement since 2026-09-21, paid in $0.001 credits; 1,000 free credits per receiving wallet, for life
costs.caveat: Rates are recomputed daily. On 2026-10-19 a Solana exact settlement cost 1.33 credits and a Base exact (EIP-3009) settlement 2.09, so the free credits covered about 750 or 480 settlements.

costs.value: 0.3 percent of each transaction executed through its facilitator, on all paid plans shown
costs.whoPays: The thirdweb account holder (the seller using its facilitator)
costs.caveat: Plan fees and RPC charges are separate.

costs.value: No facilitator fee; the operator pays gas, RPC, operations and compliance costs
Ethereum L1 about $0.01 on 2026-10-19 ($1 to $5 under normal congestion); Base under $0.005 to $0.01; Solana under $0.001 to $0.005
costs.whoPays: Facilitator on the exact EVM path and as Solana fee payer, or the merchant when it sponsors
costs.caveat: The Ethereum figure is one EIP-3009 USDC transfer measured on 2026-10-19 (81,053 gas at 0.045 gwei, ETH at $2,432). The other ranges are Spark's mid-2026 low and normal congestion estimates; gas prices move by orders of magnitude.

costs.value: Payments from $0.000001 USDC; Circle says batched settlement means neither party pays per-transaction fees
costs.whoPays: Neither party per payment (Circle). The buyer makes a one-time on-chain deposit; withdrawals pay a gas fee per burn (for example $0.01 from Base) and crosschain transfers 0.005 percent
costs.caveat: Who pays the gas for batch settlement is not stated.
x402 itself charges nothing; costs are facilitator fees and gas. cloudflare:402 is credit billed by Cloudflare as merchant of record under its own terms.
